title: InventoryStockDisposed v1 payload
description: Stock an order no longer needs was given back or written off (ADR 0169): a line removed from, or lowered on, a confirmed order, or an order cancelled after its stock was committed. disposition is what the removal reason declared for units already sold (RETURN_TO_STOCK, WRITE_OFF or NO_EFFECT); units the kitchen had started or made are written off whatever it says. Per line: units is the whole units the order no longer needed, split into releasedUnits (still a hold, given back), returnedUnits (a RETURN movement), writtenOffUnits (a RETURN and a WASTE movement) and noEffectUnits (nothing moved: an uncounted item, or declared NO_EFFECT). Identifiers, stable codes and counts only: never a customer, an address, a note or a product name (ADR 0029). A consumer resolves names through the authorized catalog API with variantId.
